system.description:
Trigger: Your Attack was dodged by a creature embedded with at least 1 Shard.

Reroll your attack and gain a +1 to the attack roll. Whether you hit or miss, 1 Shard is removed from the target.

Using this as a Swift Action causes your next attack at a creature to not require Line of Sight as long as they already have at least 1 Shard embedded. You do not suffer penalties from being [Blinded] against a creature who has a shard.
